sentences.en: Fruits and vegetables are essential to a balanced diet.
sentences.zh: 水果和蔬菜对均衡饮食至关重要。

sentences.en: Organic vegetables are popular because they're safe and tasty.
sentences.zh: 有机蔬菜很受欢迎，因为它们既安全又好吃。

sentences.en: This farm yields enough vegetables to meet our needs.
sentences.zh: 这个农场产出足够的蔬菜来满足我们的需求。

senses.zh: 植物的；蔬菜的；呆滞的，无生气的
